description:
NASA Space Apps Challenge · Interactive STEM Planetary Outpost Game

"Space-themed STEM content often oversimplifies the engineering trade-offs that define a real mission or presents them at a level too complex to hold a young learner's attention. The Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer makes those trade-offs tangible, visual, and stressful — using real planetary data from NASA's Curiosity rover."
summary: Space-themed STEM content often oversimplifies the engineering trade-offs that define real planetary exploration or presents them at a level too complex for young learners. The Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer transforms orbital mechanics, electrical load-shedding, and chemical electrolysis into an engaging, high-stakes survival loop. Students make the exact decisions aerospace engineers face: managing mass budgets, enduring planetary dust storms, and balancing life support against return-propellant production.
details:
What it does: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is a browser-based five-layer Mars outpost game where students pack a mass-limited payload, wire and power a base, and survive dust storms driven by real NASA Curiosity weather data while balancing oxygen, water, food and return fuel.

Why it matters: It turns dry engineering trade-offs into a 15-minute lesson students learn by failing and retrying, built with React, TypeScript and APIs, needing no install, account or API key — and it still runs offline.
